blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Inquirer has earned several finalist nominations in the 48th Catholic Mass Media Awards (CMMA), with its articles recognized for placing people’s experiences at the center of reporting under this year’s theme, “Preserving Human Voices and Faces.” The finalist entries span special features, investigative reporting and news coverage, reflecting the newsroom’s commitment to telling stories that go beyond headlines and statistics to document the lives, struggles and experiences of people affected by some of the country’s most consequential issues. “Lives Lost Too Soon: Children Not Spared in Duterte Drug War” by Kurt Dela Peña and “Where Priests Train […]...
